writing.overall_comment: A well-structured and semantically accurate architecture skill document that is strong as a reference but could be more actionable and example-rich for real design execution.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The skill name and description accurately match the document's focus on architecture patterns, distributed systems, technology selection, and architecture documentation.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: The document includes useful when-to-use/when-not-to-use examples, anti-patterns, and failure-oriented guidance, but lacks detailed end-to-end worked architecture examples and deeper edge-case analysis.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The phased process, checklists, and decision template provide direction, but the guidance remains largely conceptual rather than explicit, executable, and output-specific.

suggestions: In the phased process, checklists, and decision template, replace conceptual steps with explicit, executable, output-specific instructions and required artifacts for each phase.
In the examples section, add at least one detailed end-to-end worked architecture example that follows the process from requirements through decisions to final design.
In the failure-oriented guidance and anti-patterns section, add deeper edge-case analysis with concrete boundary conditions and prescribed handling for each.
